questions.question: Which coloured structure regulates how much light enters the eye through the pupil?
questions.explanation: The iris controls the size of the pupil and thereby regulates how much light enters the eye.

questions.question: Why does the eye have a physiological blind spot?
options: The cornea has no blood vessels
The lens blocks part of the retina
The optic disc has no photoreceptors
The iris absorbs all peripheral light
questions.explanation: At the optic disc, retinal ganglion-cell axons leave the eye to form the optic nerve; the region has no photoreceptors and produces the blind spot.

questions.question: Which wavelength range most closely corresponds to visible light for human vision?
questions.explanation: Visible light is commonly described as spanning approximately 400 to 700 nanometres.
